title: Kad Ucapan Raya Haji| Kad Ucapan | Wish Card
description:
Kad Ucapan Raya Haji| Kad Ucapan | Wish Card

- Price is for 1 piece of card
- Material : Art Card 250~260 gsm
- Card size : 7cm x 7cm
- High quality and bright color printing
- One side Printing only (printing bahagian depan sahaja, bahagian belakang kosong boleh tulis)

- Unfolded : Tiada lipatan, sekeping sahaja, boleh tulis di bahagian belakang card

- FAST SHIPPING

Jika ada sebarang request boleh chat dengan kami.

Note :
- Due to different lighting and screen settings, the color of the product may be slightly different from the pictures.

- Manual measurement may differ by 0.5~1 cm

- Thank you for your understanding. Don't hesitate to PM us for any inquires, we are always ready to help you.
